title: Prove exact paid switching periods for two recursive types (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, no new kappa. The first strict contraction for two synchronized recursive modes can occur arbitrarily late even after every cyclic mode conversion is charged.

```text
A = diag(2, 1/2), B = diag(2^(-N), 2^(N-1)), N >= 2
Every cyclic mode change inserts the recursive adapter 2^h I, h >= 0.
Exact minimum supplier-layer count = (2h+1)(2N+1).
Attaining word = A^((2h+1)(2N-1)) B^(4h+2).
Both adapters included: complete product = I/2.
```

This rules out a composition-depth bound based only on the two computational types and two modes in this model. The proof also supplies positive rational phase reserves with a unit charge at every stage and positive integer child-rank realizations at every rational exponent between zero and one. The phase-expanded dimension and matrix bit lengths grow with the period.

Positive-vector and periodic-product certificates are classical and already retained in the analytic theory A051/A054/A055/A057. Ross Richardson's #2881 treats a different single-type seed-switching model; Gonzalo Mier's #4034 records the existing fixed typed-matrix method. Neither predecessor is audited or replayed. Fornasini and Valcher's classical switched-system results retain their credit, DOI 10.1109/TAC.2011.2173416. The exact paid dyadic period family and minimum are the new scoped contribution, produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

Before: the complete literal search through twelve layers finds no profitable word for N=2,h=1. After: the exact fifteen-layer word A^9 B^6 pays two adapters and has product I/2. At exponent 1/2, parent width 16 gives A child counts (8,2), B=(1,8), and adapters=(8,8). The complete seventeen-stage macro has 2^33 descendants at size ratio 2^(-68), with abstract recurrence exponent 33/68.

- All 49,140 literal cyclic words through length twelve at N=2,3,4 and h=0,1 match a separately implemented 2 by 2 Fraction matrix oracle.
- All 550,298 realizable layer-count/switch-count triples through the predicted first passing length, at N=2 through 8 and h=0 through 3, have the predicted minimum under an independent integer child-multiplicity comparison.
- All 155 attaining words, 288 positive phase-reserve equations and 672 rational-exponent stage realizations pass. Eighteen mathematical and boundary controls reject or detect the specified defects. Receipts are generated and bind all seven package files.
- CPython 3.12.15, standard library only: direct warning-strict normal and optimized replay, both registered commands, metadata/pins, in-memory compilation, whitespace checks, committed bytes and declared source history pass. The separately timed scientific commands each finish in under five seconds locally; each registered limit is 180 seconds.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/paid-typed-period/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/paid-typed-period/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paid-typed-period
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/paid-typed-period --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 interpreter may replace the displayed path. Expected markers are PASS_PAID_TYPED_PERIOD, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES.

## Limitations

This is an explicitly declared analytical side result from coverage-law-change. There is no actual native supplier or physical producer/consumer. The synchronized-mode restriction, exact diagonal matrices, cyclic return and specified recursive adapters are essential. Independent mode choice by computational type escapes this obstruction. No input-dependent search bound is excluded. The implementation has finite parameter limits; the written proof holds for every integer N>=2,h>=0.

Integer child moments do not establish a useful target operation, dirty restoration, ownership, stock, precision/tape or outer recovery. Selected cold replay, native replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Open next questions

Does an actual source-compatible caller require synchronized recursive modes with a favorable paid period? First extract both mode contracts and their full type-specific child lists, including conversions at both boundaries. Physical producer/consumer, native, restoration, precision and storage costs remain the blockers. This result does not justify expanding an abstract search without that caller.

## Related open work

No other open PR studying this synchronized dyadic period family or its minimum was found after refreshing the account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM and the latest handoff posts on 2026-10-30. The newer open contributions concern different objects and quantities. Broader supplier-admission and fixed-matrix work does not supply this paid period theorem. Search coverage is bounded and is not a novelty certificate.

The completed checks were read once, and the run metadata confirms the matching head and successful conclusion. These checks replay the registered finite evidence; they do not establish physical supplier admission or independent human/formal proof-kernel review.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one new research package and its two registered replay commands. No shared implementation or selected-frontier file changes.
